text: Returns policy (Victoria): undamaged products can be returned in Victoria, subject to a 20% restocking fee. Faulty products can always be replaced regardless of state.
scope_note: Business policy, not a technical or compliance claim.

text: Returns policy (interstate): returns or exchanges are not accepted for interstate orders, except for faulty products, which can be replaced.
scope_note: Business policy, not a technical or compliance claim.

text: Most products have an estimated time of arrival (ETA) of 2 to 3 business days. Warehouse pickups are a 3-to-5 business day window, as delivery times can vary and are outside the business's direct control. Delivery or pickup timelines depend on the clearing method used for payment (e.g. bank transfers can take 2-3 business days); order processing and dispatch only begin after funds have fully cleared in the business bank account. No fulfilment timeline is committed to, and no order is placed with suppliers, before funds have cleared.
scope_note: Business policy, not a technical or compliance claim.

text: The Victoria warehouse operates 6 AM to 1 PM for customer pickups, with potential flexibility for later pickups by prior arrangement, and Saturday pickups available on request. The Queensland warehouse (Virginia) operates strictly within its standard operating hours, with no flexibility for extensions.
scope_note: Business policy, not a technical or compliance claim.

topic: Services the business does not offer
text: This business operates on a supply-only basis. It does not offer or perform installation services, removal or vacuuming of existing insulation, or tool hire. Customers needing those services should engage a licensed installer or removalist directly.
scope_note: Business policy, not a technical or compliance claim.

text: Product origin, bulkiness, and transportation cost affect whether a product can be delivered cost-effectively to a given destination. Bulky products (such as polyester batts) are not well suited to long-distance interstate transit. Some suppliers do not ship to the Northern Territory or Western Australia. Geographic and shipping feasibility must be confirmed for a customer's delivery location before a product is recommended purely on manufacturer preference.
scope_note: Business policy, not a technical or compliance claim. Specific supplier/state restrictions must be confirmed with the supplier for the exact destination.

text: Products explicitly marked as 'no split packing' must be supplied in their original packaging only; split packing is not offered for those items.
scope_note: Business policy, not a technical or compliance claim. Applies only to SKUs flagged as no-split-packing in the catalogue.
